name: Spinner Orbit Dots
description: Multiple dots arranged in a circle orbit continuously with a fading tail effect

variations.name: default
variations.description: Dots arranged in a radial pattern rotate together as a group, with opacity gradient creating a comet-tail effect

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: dotCount
props.description: Number of dots in the orbital ring

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each individual dot in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
